description: For \(A\to B\in\Delta\), a supplied cut-free premise \(p:\Delta\Rightarrow A\), continuation \(q:\Delta,B\Rightarrow C\), and environment \(\eta:\Delta\Rightarrow\Gamma\), interpreting their implication-left step equals interpreting \(q\) in the environment extended by the neutral application of \(\eta(A\to B)\) to \(V(p,\eta)\).
